ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on IT systems that may contribute to social services fraud.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover potential fraud and inefficiencies in Minnesota's Medicaid program.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can IT systems be improved to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential vulnerabilities in Minnesota's Medicaid program and lead to increased oversight and reform.

ideas.title: Election Integrity: A Closer Look
ideas.description: Investigate potential election integrity issues in Arizona and other states, focusing on the role of election audits and subpoenas.
ideas.angle: Analyze the impact of election audits and subpoenas on election integrity in Arizona and other states.
questions: What are the most common issues found in election audits?
How do subpoenas impact election integrity investigations?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a deeper understanding of election integrity issues and the role of audits and subpoenas in ensuring the integrity of elections.
